emma: Heads-up — noticed ~11% of inbound HubSpot leads between 00:30-00:50 ended up in unassigned, looks like enrichment blew past our RR window. Anyone on call? :eyes:

ryan: seeing p95 enrichment ~82s for that window (baseline ~12s). Our claim TTL is 30s so that explains it.

priyanka: short fixes: 1) bump claim TTL to 60s for night window 2) add HS workflow to set lifecycle=processing while enrichment pending 3) run a backfill to re-enrich and push to rr. Which do we want now?

emma: flip TTL and HS rule ASAP. I'll draft a note for Sales.

ryan: applying config: `infractl set routing.claim_ttl 60000 --scope night --env prod` — canary looks fine.

crm-bot: Webhook delivery errors: enrichment-gateway 504 x 18 events between 2024-09-12T00:33Z-00:38Z. Retries scheduled.

priyanka: backfill plan: query leads created in window with `enrich_status=pending`, POST to /api/enrich idempotent, then enqueue to rr; if still unclaimed after 90s -> overflow. I'll run it now.

emma: sales blurb: "Late-night enrichment delays caused brief assignment delays for a small set of leads. Ops extended the routing timer and reprocessed affected leads; no data lost. DM if you spot missing contacts."

priyanka: backfill completed: 178 processed -> 162 into rr, 16 to overflow. No dupes. Posting job id bf-20240912-01.

ryan: marking incident P2. Long-term ops: async enrichment, dynamic TTL based on vendor p95, and HS hold-by-default for night windows. Filing tickets.

emma: thanks — reverting TTL at 08:00 local and will attach postmortem link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
